applyTo: "graylog-sdm.flprj,Project/**,Content/**"

# MadCap Flare project review rules

`graylog-sdm.flprj`, `Project/` and `Content/` make up the MadCap Flare project that publishes the SDM reference (ADR 0007). The docs team maintains it in Flare and is still setting it up, so some parts are incomplete or still template placeholders on purpose.

- Don't comment on Flare project files (`graylog-sdm.flprj`, `Project/**`, and `Content/**` outside `Content/SDM/`): not their XML, CSS, placeholders, table of contents, targets or missing resources. They will be reviewed once the Flare setup is complete.
- `Content/SDM/**` is generated by `build-sdm build`. Don't review page content; follow the generated-output rules in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Flag a PR that adds a hand-written file under `Content/SDM/`, or that changes SDM meaning in any Flare file. SDM definitions are edited only under `src/sdm/`.
